data.name: Four Lights : The 1st World [Iruka Route]
data.detailed_description:
This package is the standalone "Iruka Route" version.

The content included is exactly the same as in the Complete Edition. However, from Route 2 onwards, you will need to either purchase the DLCs or buy the Complete Edition.

these chapters contain characters and CGs that are not part of the first and second worlds.

data.short_description: Our protagonists E.B. and Iruka have become the targets of Lucifer. With a terrorist attack being the first, various misfortunes come over them. Fight against the world alongside the angels and protect your loved ones.

Korean*, English
*languages with full audio support

content_descriptors.notes:
[Content Warning & Rating Notice]
• This game has been officially rated "15+" by the GRAC (Game Rating and Administration Committee) in South Korea.
• It contains stylized fantasy violence, combat sequences, and artistic depictions of a fictional underworld (Hell).
• It includes mentions and dark narrative contexts regarding suicide for dramatic storytelling purposes.
• There is NO explicit sexual content, NO nudity, and NO realistic glorification of self-harm. All characters and events are entirely fictional.

[콘텐츠 주의 및 심의 안내]
• 본 게임은 대한민국 게임물관리위원회(GRAC)로부터 공식적으로 '15세 이용가' 판정을 받은 작품입니다.
• 서사적 전개를 위한 일부 판타지적 폭력, 전투 연출 및 가상의 지옥을 표현한 예술적 묘사가 포함되어 있습니다.
• 극적 장치로서 자살에 대한 언급 및 어두운 서사적 맥락이 포함되어 있습니다.
• 노골적인 성적 콘텐츠, 누드, 또는 실제 자해를 조장하거나 미화하는 요소는 일절 존재하지 않습니다. 게임에 등장하는 모든 인물과 사건은 허구입니다.
